MANDATORY. Index every chunk in both Cyrillic and Latin. 'Нумеричка математика' / 'Numerička matematika' / 'numericka_matematika' are three surface forms of one entity and the site mixes all three. Also index the ASCII-folded form (č->c, š->s, ž->z, ć->c, đ->dj) because users type without diacritics.

change_detection.why: There is no RSS feed, no sitemap and no working pagination anywhere on imi.pmf.kg.ac.rs. This is the cheap replacement and it is better than a feed.
notes: The slug after the ID is decorative — only the leading integer resolves. '-x' is enough.
The hyphen plus at least one character is REQUIRED: /vesti/18845 returns 404, /vesti/18845-x returns the article.
IDs are shared by news AND notice-board items and increase monotonically with publication time.
IDs are never reused or renumbered — safe as vector-DB primary keys. Use the integer, not the URL.
A 404 renders 'Tražena stranica nije nađena.' — trivial string match.
Gaps of 4+ consecutive missing IDs occur naturally. Allow ~20 consecutive 404s before declaring the head reached.

daily_supplement.why: article pages carry NO publication date and NO author. The notice-board table is the only place the DD.MM.YYYY date and author exist. Fetch it once a day purely to harvest that metadata.
daily_supplement.warning: hard-capped rolling window of 30 items with NO pagination and NO archive. During exam season (~10 posts/week) the whole window turns over in ~3 days. Poll at least daily, twice daily in June-July and late August.

attachment_change_detection.method: diff the /pub/ hrefs on the parent page
attachment_change_detection.why: the /pub/{md5}_{MMDDYYYY_HHMMSS}/ directory changes on every re-upload, so a changed href means a revised document — no need to download the PDF to know it changed
attachment_change_detection.warning: the timestamp is US-style MMDDYYYY, inverted relative to the DD.MM.YYYY the site displays. Easy parsing bug.

course_syllabi.note: 156 individual course syllabus PDFs — one per subject. These are the single best chunk-per-document source in the whole corpus: each holds course name, ECTS, prerequisites, goals, content, literature and grading. No course has an HTML page; the PDF IS the course page. Directory listings return 403, so build the URLs from the slugs below or harvest the hrefs from the two program pages.
warnings: The site's own slugs contain typos — do NOT 'correct' them: strukutre_podataka_i_algoritmi_2, kompresija_i_zatita_podataka, teorija_izracunljivosti_i_racunske_komplesnosti, logicko_i_funkcijsko_programiranja (informatics, ends -a).

Some basenames exist in MULTIPLE directories with DIFFERENT content (zavrsni_rad, strucna_praksa, numericka_matematika, baze_podataka_1, racunarski_sistemi, osnovi_programiranja, uvod_u_finansijsku_matematiku). Key your vector-DB document ID on the FULL PATH, never the basename.
Math and informatics spell two shared courses differently: klijentske_veb_tehnologije (math) vs klijentske_web_tehnologije (informatics).
VERIFIED: the two typo'd filenames really do resolve, and the PDFs spell the course correctly INSIDE. Any spell-correction in your config will 404 them.

Two different PDF templates are in use: mat_os/ files open directly with 'Студијски програм: ...', while 2026/ and 2026-mas/ files open with a faculty letterhead block first. A parser keyed to a fixed line offset will misread one family.
A nonexistent slug returns an empty HTML shell rather than a 404 — check for an empty/HTML body, not just the status code.
course_syllabi.verified: 2026-08-24 — 6 files sampled across all three directories, all resolved with an extractable Cyrillic text layer (no OCR needed). Fields present: Студијски програм, Назив предмета, Статус, Број ЕСПБ, Услов, Циљ, Исход, Садржај (теоријска/практична настава), Литература, Број часова, Методе извођења, Оцена знања.
